en: Making a home for his white falcon
Covering it with precious ornament
Driving cattle toward the mountain
Digging a pit where baltyrgan grew
Plating it in pure gold
Having the nobles praise it
The open face of the mountain
Saying none would remain standing
Surrounding its bounds twice
So none might come and ruin it
O ruthless Chinese people
Chyng Teñir, who knew how to command
To the host spread across the heights
Across the stone-strewn plain
To the champion clad for the child
Upon the great commanding summit
He surveyed the broad world
His founding ancestor was Nogoy Khan,
Let us begin the tale from ancient times.
His earlier ancestor was Böyön Khan,
He became khan in a foreign steppe,
[?] made the land his own,
The dear land that saw the White Kalmyks,
[?] made the land his own,
Nogoy Khan, a man of fortune.
Men were forged by the khanate,
Fighting, the enemy was defeated,
His [?] became aflame,
Sayan established a royal camp.
Descended from Sayan Khan,
Ordering that one to be sacrificed,
All the peoples of the age,
Karakhan himself descended [from him],
There his eye could not see,
Khans and elders sprang from noble stock,
A gray stallion that would let no horse escape,
Radiant elders and khans arose,
Becoming a foe who advanced alone,
The world became anguish to the heart,
Setting his aim broadly,
His equal was truly his match,
Many people descended [from him],
They attained a homeland on earth,
He acted together with heroes,
Burak made them a people,
From Tara Khan came Bala Khan,
He became khan while still young,
Generous to warriors, open-handed,
He was an incomparable soul,
From Bala Khan came Nogoy Khan,
Who could be mightier than Nogoy Khan?
They followed according to his word,
He slaughtered anyone who rose against him,
When he set his sights, he became a fierce khan,
In combat he was a formidable man,
From Nogoy Khan came Kara Khan,
The son of Kara Khan,
His troubled thoughts churned,
When that Kara Khan died,
Enemies gathered and confronted [them],
Kara Khan’s eight sons,
With twisted tongues and sullen faces,
They bore grudges and went about arrogantly,
They made [people] bow their heads in many lands,
To one I shall tell of her husband,
Casting [it] down upon another [?],
To one, gold [?],
To one I shall tell [what was] sent,
If he goes to the land of Kelbet,
Of one I shall tell [?],
He had sent one of them to China,
The progeny of Kara Kan,
From Kara Kyz and Jakyp,
From the dark-maned Manas,
From the young gray-maned Börü,
In the summer season of the hunt,
May your seeing eye be keen
May it render what it sees exactly
Making many rich men tremble
Unable to overcome his wealth
He set his aim upon wisdom
He cursed those he besieged
The time had come for his turning
He would ask and seek what he desired
As though gathering the people together
That Kalmyk domain
The time had come for its slaughter
Those remaining seemed to beg
The time had come for his turning
It was a sacred word
They were his very own eyes
He was a model leader of men
Four thousand under Ak Joltoy
Six dark ones like servants
We have come to meet in combat
Gray-wolf Joltoy from the steppe
We have come to face him
May your wish be fulfilled
With no enemy expected in mind
Raise your gun
Take the host under command
Remain and offer a prayer
This will be our day of harsh battle
Stand and speak your words
This will be our day of heavenly favor
Stand through your prayer
Know what we have undertaken
Heed the words of one who has become wise
There is a horse famed before all eyes
She had craved a tiger
There is a woman like a peri
Saying this is tiger flesh
Prepare the offering
A gray pacer like a blue hammer
Give it to the worthy soul
A soul lay where the tamarisk grew
Its tomb spread wings
They wrap the beast in a hero’s flesh
How far he will surpass your tiger
One startled by Medina
A dragon from a distant land
That dragon sat there
God-given fortune gathered
Behind the dragon
From where the clan had scattered
Making one form resemble a living being
Joining it into flowing speech
To give it as a trust
You shall give it to this soul
Unable to restrain Malkesh
He surges with a lamb’s-length stride
His ruined affair will be set right
Talas will become a settled people
Talgaz and Kenen of the host
Accept the dark master
Khan-warrior Kenen will become a hero
That one’s name is Kenen
He also looked toward the year
When he looked anew
A new age was to be born
Pierce the mountain ninety times
Name him Kenen
If she gives birth to Kenen
Night will fall over Talas
A soul known as Agyn’s son
Saying this one had been born
His enemies stretching beyond sight
He will conquer them in his breast
He will bend whoever confronts him
He will have the rest slaughtered
Your enemy’s peace
Now let Kenen prevail
The enemy before his eyes will shriek
If the leopard returns, Kenen’s land
All of it will be smashed to pieces
His roaming might will be great
The hero’s name will be mighty
He will be a dragonlike warrior
The earth’s mane will be seen
A magnanimous one greater than Beijing
A lineage from the khan’s own blood
A lineage born from a great people
A lark does not fear plain cloth
That one is Borun Teñir
He fears no torment
Our mother Kurt whom we saw
If the day comes to speak decisively
He will be a hero above others
His nature is that of an orator
That warrior will settle the people’s affairs
That is the hero whose sight brings fortune
To all his people against the foe
Across many lands in his time
Saying, here is my son Kenen
If entered in the race, he has fortune
Cast into fire, he will not burn
Against the enemy from Oron
He will not cease from destroying them
His world will reach many
The unwitting Chinese will lose their lives
This decree that was given
From the mouth of white-blessed Cheytek
He gave its sign as a trust
See the dwelling that was granted
Raise and watch the floating banner
So he may ride hard into holy war
Like lords who built paradise
Resourceful since birth
His grieving form was there in the dust
Straight before dark eyes
A human creature
There upon the ground before choosing eyes
The kulan among the countless herd
A great Kalmyk departed from the clan
Askar of Kojobay
Kylkara of the sickle-bearing people
The blue tongue of the gray-eyed one
A bare secret among a thousand
The burden of an evil claim
They joined battle with those men
They fought with the Chinese
He was greatly blessed
There was a mark upon the wolf
Coming swiftly from the diviners
Swift horses with noble bearing
Wondering if his third eye was keen
His gold shone so brightly
His banner went into the tumult
Many ancestors protected him
His stride stretched like a fox’s
By God’s decree the day arrived
It will swiftly come upon this people
The mist-gray pacer gives chase
This is the one touched by sunlight
The seal of his eye is a blazing peak
When seen, he multiplies into a thousand
A soul touched by the blue saint
His paths will not be constrained by foes
If they say he shrinks from the enemy
No lone people will escape him
If you do not speak calmly, he errs
For my young lord Kenen
The brave Joltoy is entrusted
As a trust I gave a horse
I gave a horse like a dragon
I told the secret to the root lineage
I described its crane-like form
Without telling others, he growled
My child, this is Joltoy
I spoke faithfully of your acquaintance
Attend to the words I spoke
He became a man and a hero
To warriors who had gone astray
To the sacred clan
Ten followed behind him
If you are the peerless heir
Joltoy, heed the spoken word
Advance, Joltoy, when driven
You are the eye of the true gray wolf
Heroic gray wolf Seyteke
You are the true heir
I set out for the hunt
Wisdom beyond counting
Saying he would see the famed face
Saying he would deliver his trust
How I have sought you
May what you seek be accepted
The enemy who opposes you
Dear Joltoy, I shall find him
Tears pressed down from grief
His brow opened through the night
Concerning the passage of days
The Creator directs your striving
I came with your eagle
My child Joltoy, into your hand
This creature with the bay charger
